Other staged cases passed earlier in this work session before final shared-dependency resolution and malformed-output guard fixes; not relabelled as final-identity full coverage.

protocolRestart.boundary: Existing local disposable deployment only; no Docker/system restart

shadowRestart.metricScope: Process memory; context HTTP plus local verification/scoring, excluding report HTTP

operational.scope: Local tests with an artificial 10s Oracle-2 delay and Oracle-1 restart; successful-attempt timer excludes its abandoned pre-crash attempt. Not normal-network latency, peak memory, throughput or fraud accuracy.

problemsAndCorrections: Initial Docker/backend unavailability and native Windows Node failures interrupted early attempts. User reopened Desktop; only the existing container was started. No Docker/WSL/system settings changed.
Windows reboot interrupted active attempts; they are not counted as successful checks. Subsequent tests ran serially with optional per-process RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 and UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2.

Browser monitoring assertion found valid mined results rejected because worker proof diagnostics extended the stored routing receipt. Compare canonical routing fields, validate the result hash, and store the pinned receipt; regression and real-browser reruns passed.
API-only source packaging reproduced missing ethers resolution in shared protocol hashing. Resolve from the installed API or Oracle subsystem; focused package test and final browser checks passed.
Malformed/nonfinite/out-of-range inference output lacked an explicit wrapper guard. Added fail-closed validation with regression coverage; final protocol package and live worker reruns passed.
Final diff check found mixed CRLF additions in two un-hashed backend files; normalized line endings and reran synchronization/repository checks.

limitations: No new natural-fraud accuracy or predictive-superiority evidence. Existing constructed-study weaknesses remain: held-out-family recall 6.56% and shifted review up to 34.63%.
Matching workers share the model, code and registry publisher; exact agreement is not independent clinical truth.
First-decision recovery depends on backend/Mongo availability and pinned archive proof availability. Total outage may delay/reach timeout; no alternative result is manufactured.
Dispatcher supports the named NB and XGBoost-v1 artifacts, not arbitrary later model versions. Archive/register old evaluators before a future update.
Slither was not installed/available; no fresh Slither analysis. Docker source inclusion was checked, but images were not built.
No actual Brevo mail, public-chain deployment/fee observation, hosted migration, hosted transaction regression or hosted revision inspection.
InsuranceManager remains 24,320 deployed bytes: 256 bytes below EIP-170. No new Solidity bytecode was added.
Operational timing samples include artificial Oracle-2 delay/restart; not normal latency, throughput or peak-memory claims.
